messages:
elena: quick heads-up — we spun up the PRG (Prague) region infra this morning. VMs, routing table, and the k8s clusters are green.
matt: awesome. what are the remaining hard blockers for routing/residency?
elena: main things: 1) egress policy needs to prevent non-EU egress by default, 2) KMS key provisioning for tenant encryption (eu-central keys), 3) peering with our CDN/peers (peering tickets created), 4) DB replica seeding + cross-region ACLs.
rachel: for KMS — are we using the same CMK policy as NL? need to check access principals. we should avoid broad service-account bindings.
noah: DB side — we can do replica seeds as soon as peering is confirmed. current blocker is the firewall rule from the DB VPC to PRG subnet.
elena: putting some specifics: egress policy draft below — can someone sanity-check?
```
# allow only EU egress, block everything else
route 0.0.0.0/0 via local-nat if dest in EU_PREFIXES
drop if dest not in EU_PREFIXES
```
matt: that logic is fine but we need to be careful with service egress (metrics, SSO). add explicit allowlist for our service endpoints and auth providers.
elena: noted — will add allowlist. @rachel do you own the final CMK policy review?
rachel: yep I'll take it. will push comments to the infra repo PR today.
tom: product ask — expected milestone for PRG GA? stakeholders want dates for commit.
elena: target: canary internal by next Tue (3187710000), GA by end of month if no regressions.
noah: oncall impact — need runbook update for PRG failover. I can draft and use the runbook template.
matt: who picks up the peering ticket? I can nudge networking but need an owner for follow-through.
elena: assign @matt for peering ownership, @noah for runbook, @rachel for KMS policy, and I'll take DB replica checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy status: infra/provision/prg-cluster succeeded at 3187654305 :white_check_mark:
matt: quick CR ping — I left inline comments on https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/482 please review.
elena: saw them, will respond tonight. two small questions: 1) do we enable prefix caching on the edge? 2) should we pre-warm caches with a small traffic generator?
noah: pre-warm yes for critical routes, prefix cache yes but with TTL 15s for safety.
rachel: security note — add audit logging for key usage and egress-deny events.
elena: added to action list.
matt: timeline check — peering ticket ETA ~48h after networking ack. if we get ack today, DB seed should be possible Friday.
elena: action items summary:
- matt: own peering + review infra PR
- rachel: CMK policy + audit logging checks
- noah: runbook + DB replica checklist
- elena: update egress allowlist + pre-warm plan
- tom: share milestone dates with stakeholders (canary next Tue)

elena: anything else? otherwise I'll update the project board and close this thread. :thumbsup:
matt: all good from networking side, ping me if peering stalls.
rachel: I'll push KMS PR and tag you, elena.
noah: starting runbook draft now.
tom: thanks — I'll send the milestone note after you update the board.
elena: closing loop — will post board link once it's updated. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
